gen-gf-turret-road-gf-varela-round: Round forms like open parentheses give Turret Road its look, drawn in one pen-like line. Varela Round follows with wide-mouthed lowercase curves, so the two feel friendly and firm together without either one shouting.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-varta: Varta brings big open eyes on every e and a, set under a Turret Road heading with no hairlines anywhere. Over a long page it reads easily.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-vazirmatn: Open and approachable, this body face keeps its s wide and never lets it tighten. Vazirmatn gives Turret Road's bent-wire letters something friendly to lean on, and that warmth is the pair's best trait.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-wix-madefor-displa: Bold bars and round bends! Turret Road draws horizontals as heavy as its upright stems, while Wix Madefor Display softens things with gently flared curve ends that stay apart, which is the pair's real charm.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-wix-madefor-text: Turret Road draws bowls and stems at the same weight, bold and commanding. Wix Madefor Text sits beneath it with open, easy terminals, so the heading makes the statement and the plain sans carries the explaining.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-ysabeau: Think neon sign tube: Turret Road keeps a single track width through every curve. Ysabeau follows with sweeping curves that never close up, so long paragraphs keep moving without feeling cramped.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-ysabeau-infant: Ysabeau Infant flicks its terminals outward like a pair of tongs. Turret Road is the one for bold, unmodulated statements, while the plain sans does its best work quietly, in approachable running text.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-ysabeau-office: Ysabeau Office gives every curved letter an open-ended look that feels modern and easy to follow. And Turret Road, drawn with the steadiness of a technical pen, stands over it with round, commanding confidence.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-ysabeau-sc: Commanding from the first letter, Turret Road draws every stroke at one thickness in round, parenthesis-like forms. Ysabeau SC answers with a visibly gaping c, so give that plain sans a little room to show it.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-zalando-sans: Turret Road is bold and commanding, with a thin-free, swell-free stroke that never changes. Zalando Sans gives curved letters an open-ended look, so a long stretch of text feels neutral and approachable.
